description: This file defines the FileCookieJar class in the GuzzleHttp library, responsible for persisting cookies to a JSON file and loading them back, extending the CookieJar class.

classes.name: FileCookieJar
classes.description: A class that persists non-session cookies using a JSON formatted file, extending CookieJar to add persistence functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cookie jar with a filename and option to store session cookies, loading existing cookies if the file exists.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that saves cookies to the file when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current cookies to a specified filename in JSON format.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from a JSON formatted file, adding them to the cookie jar.
